desc: Implement fast input/output and prefix sums P[0..N]; derive and unit-check the right/left blocker inequalities, especially strict `<` versus `>=` equality cases.
Build two segment trees/RMQ structures over transformed keys supporting directional threshold queries (`first_leq` on Rkey=P[j-1]-A[j], `last_geq` on Lkey=P[i]+A[i]).
Write the per-K closure simulator: maintain `[l,r]`, alternately jump right then left using blocker queries until fixed point, return interval sum.
Doubling/termination argument: each blocker crossing at least doubles current size, bounding rounds by log(total sum) < 49; verified against Sample 1 (K=4 → 13) by hand-trace.
Iterative segment trees with leaf-climb/sibling-scan queries, freed input arrays, single-line output formatting for N=5e5.
